verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe Devin Review, which gives automated first-pass reviews on pull requests, checking correctness and conformance with organizational best practices. Its Auto-Fix mode responds to review comments and CI failures, so the product directly delivers automated, context-aware PR review. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that review triggers on every PR automatically, detail on how the contextual feedback is produced (e.g., codebase or knowledge grounding in reviews), and independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request

citations.quote: Devin Review provides automated first-pass reviews on pull requests, checking for correctness and conformance with organizational best practices.
With Auto-Fix enabled, Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
